```{python}
#| label: fig-layout-cap-matching
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Precisely matched capacitor pair with $C_1 = 8 C_2$, built from identical unit capacitors: the single $C_2$ unit sits at the common centroid of the eight $C_1$ units, and a ring of grounded dummy capacitors (D) ensures that every active unit sees identical surroundings."

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle

C1, C2, DU = '#64a0e8', '#e57373', '#dddddd'

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(5, 5))

n = 5
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(n):
        if i in (0, n - 1) or j in (0, n - 1):
            c, t = DU, 'D'
        elif i == 2 and j == 2:
            c, t = C2, '$C_2$'
        else:
            c, t = C1, '$C_1$'
        ax.add_patch(Rectangle((i + 0.07, j + 0.07), 0.86, 0.86, fc=c,
                               ec='k', lw=0.8))
        ax.text(i + 0.5, j + 0.5, t, fontsize=9, ha='center', va='center')

ax.set_xlim(-0.2, n + 0.2)
ax.set_ylim(-0.2, n + 0.2)
ax.set_aspect('equal')
ax.axis('off')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
